gameDescriptionHtml:
The Qi has awakened demons, they wreak havoc on our world. You traverse ancient realms with the aid of the “Kunlun Mirror,” embarking on a journey of cultivation and acension to gods.

More than 20 swords to choose, each with a unique attack style. Whether to motive your sword by the force of five elements or the power from underworld, it’s all about a moment of thought. Up to 90 kinds of splendid swordsmanship and 24 schools can be selected at your will. Slash the enemy through exquisite skills or unleash an abyss of blood engulfing everything?

Game Features

  • Treasures – Over 70 treasures to collect, providing different buffs and even additional skills. Gathering the weapon’s forging terms in every cycle of reincarnation to create a mighty, legendary weapon.
  • Monsters – Monsters have returned, and only the sharp blade in thy hand can save the realm. Travel between time and space, encountering marvelous adventures, unraveling the mystery behind the temporal collapse.
  • Talents – Cultivate the meridians, nurture cinnabar fields and study the martial arts from various sects.
